title: Introduction to Databases
description: Learn how a database stores, protects and retrieves data. We cover tables, keys, SQL queries and why every serious application needs a reliable database.

title: Data Modelling in Practice
description: Turn a real-world problem into an entity relationship model and map it to relational tables. Includes normalization and common modelling mistakes.

title: Backend Engineering with NestJS
description: Build a REST API with NestJS and TypeORM. Controllers, services, dependency injection, validation and end-to-end tests against a PostgreSQL database.

title: Containers and Docker
description: Package applications with Docker and run whole stacks with Docker Compose. Images, volumes, networks and reproducible development environments.

title: Information Retrieval and Search
description: How search engines find documents among millions. Tokenization, inverted indexes, ranking with TF-IDF and BM25, and how to measure search quality.

title: Advanced SQL and Query Optimization
description: Window functions, common table expressions and indexes. Read query plans and make slow database queries fast.

title: NoSQL Databases
description: Document stores, key-value stores and graph databases compared with relational systems. When a schema-free database is the right choice and when it is not.

title: Web Design
description: Design pages people enjoy using. Layout, typography, colour and accessibility, and how a design becomes a working website.

title: Frontend Engineering with React
description: Components, state and hooks in React. Fetch data from an API, handle forms and write maintainable user interfaces.

title: Web Development Fundamentals
description: HTML, CSS and JavaScript from the ground up. Build responsive pages and connect them to a backend API.

title: Game Development
description: Game loops, physics and rendering. Build a small 2D game and learn what performance really means.

title: Web Development Studio
description: A project studio for small teams. Plan, build and launch a web application for a real client, from the first sketch to the deployed site.

title: Machine Learning Basics
description: Supervised and unsupervised learning, training and evaluating models, overfitting and the data preparation that makes or breaks a project.

title: Natural Language Processing
description: Turn text into numbers. Tokenization, stemming, embeddings and text classification, with a project on searching large document collections.

title: Big Data Processing
description: Process datasets that do not fit on one machine. Batch and stream processing, partitioning, and the trade-offs of distributed systems.

title: Cloud Computing
description: Virtual machines, managed databases, object storage and serverless functions. Design an application that scales and costs little when idle.

title: Software Engineering and Testing
description: Version control, code review and automated testing. Write unit tests, integration tests and end-to-end tests that catch real bugs.

title: Information Security
description: Authentication, authorization, encryption and the most common web vulnerabilities. Protect an API and the data behind it.

title: Data Warehousing and Analytics
description: Design a data warehouse with fact and dimension tables. Load data with ETL pipelines and answer business questions with aggregations.

title: Data Visualization
description: Choose the right chart for your data. Build dashboards that explain results clearly instead of decorating them.

title: Distributed Systems
description: Replication, consensus and failure. Why distributed databases and search clusters split data into shards and keep copies on several nodes.

title: Mobile App Engineering
description: Build a cross-platform mobile app that talks to a REST API, stores data offline and syncs it when the network returns.

title: Human-Computer Interaction
description: Design interfaces people can actually use. User research, prototyping and usability testing, including the design of search boxes and filters.

title: Operating Systems
description: Processes, threads, memory management and file systems. Understand what the machine does when your program runs.

title: Computer Networks
description: From Ethernet to HTTP. IP addressing, routing, TCP and DNS, and how a request travels from browser to server.

title: Algorithms and Data Structures
description: Lists, trees, hash tables and graphs. Analyze running time and choose the data structure that keeps your program fast.

title: Recommender Systems
description: Suggest products and content with collaborative filtering and content-based methods. Evaluate recommendations with real user data.

title: API Design and Documentation
description: Design REST APIs that are consistent and easy to use. Versioning, pagination, error handling and OpenAPI documentation.

title: Database Administration
description: Backup and recovery, user permissions, monitoring and replication for PostgreSQL. Keep a production database healthy.

title: Graph Databases
description: Model connected data as nodes and relationships. Query social networks and recommendation graphs with a graph query language.

title: Search-Driven Applications
description: Add full-text search to a web application. Index documents, rank results, correct typos and keep the search index in sync with the main database.

title: Logging and Monitoring
description: Collect logs and metrics, search them quickly and alert on problems. Dashboards for the health of a running service.

title: TypeScript in Depth
description: Types, generics and decorators. Write safer JavaScript and understand how frameworks such as NestJS use the type system.

title: Project Management for Developers
description: Plan, estimate and deliver software in a team. Agile methods, issue tracking and honest communication with stakeholders.

title: Statistics for Data Science
description: Probability, distributions and hypothesis tests. Draw sound conclusions from data and avoid the classic statistical traps.

title: Open Source Practice
description: Contribute to a real open source project. Read unfamiliar code, write a good pull request and work with maintainers.

title: Entrepreneurship for Engineers
description: From idea to first customers. Validate a product, build a small team and understand the basics of funding.

title: Data Ethics and Privacy
description: GDPR, consent and responsible handling of personal data. What developers must consider before storing or indexing user data.

title: Embedded Systems
description: Program microcontrollers, read sensors and control actuators. Real-time constraints and low-level debugging.

title: Continuous Integration and Delivery
description: Automate builds, tests and deployments. Build pipelines that ship small changes safely and often.

title: Knowledge Graphs and Linked Data
description: Describe knowledge so machines can use it. Ontologies, linked data and querying large knowledge graphs.

title: Capstone Project
description: Build a complete application in a team, from data model and API to deployment. Present the result and defend your design decisions.
